verses.en: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.
verses.pt: E conhecendo Joabe, filho de Zeruia, que o coração do rei estava por Absalão,
verses.en_web: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.
verses.en_bbe: Now it was clear to Joab, the son of Zeruiah, that the king's heart was turning to Absalom.

verses.en: And Joab sent to Tekoah, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:
verses.pt: Enviou Joabe a Tecoa, e tomou dali uma mulher astuta, e disse-lhe: Eu te rogo que te enlutes, e te vistas de roupas de luto, e não te unjas com óleo, antes sê como mulher que há muito tempo que traze luto por algum morto;
verses.en_web: Joab sent to Tekoa, and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on mourning clothing, please, and don’t anoint yourself with oil, but be as a woman who has mourned a long time for the dead.
verses.en_bbe: And Joab sent to Tekoa and got from there a wise woman, and said to her, Now make yourself seem like one given up to grief, and put on the clothing of sorrow, not using any sweet oil for your body, but looking like one who for a long time has been weeping for the dead:

verses.en: And come to the king, and speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.
verses.pt: E entrando ao rei, fala com ele desta maneira. E pôs Joabe as palavras em sua boca.
verses.en_web: Go in to the king, and speak like this to him.” So Joab put the words in her mouth.
verses.en_bbe: And come to the king and say these words to him. So Joab gave her words to say.

verses.en: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.
verses.pt: Entrou, pois, aquela mulher de Tecoa ao rei, e prostrando-se em terra sobre seu rosto fez reverência, e disse: Ó rei, socorre-me!
verses.en_web: When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, showed respect, and said, “Help, O king!”
verses.en_bbe: And the woman of Tekoa came to the king, and falling on her face, gave him honour and said, Give me help, O king.

verses.en: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I am indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.
verses.pt: E o rei disse: Que tens? E ela respondeu: Eu à verdade sou uma mulher viúva e meu marido é morto.
verses.en_web: The king said to her, “What ails you?” She answered, “Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead.
verses.en_bbe: And the king said to her, What is your trouble? And her answer was, Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead.

verses.en: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him.
verses.pt: E tua serva tinha dois filhos e os dois brigaram no campo; e não havendo quem os separasse, feriu o um à outra, e o matou.
verses.en_web: Your servant had two sons, and they both fought together in the field, and there was no one to part them, but the one struck the other, and killed him.
verses.en_bbe: And I had two sons, and the two of them had a fight in the field, and there was no one to come between them, and one with a blow put the other to death.

verses.en: And, behold, the whole family is risen against thine handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth.
verses.pt: E eis que toda a parentela se levantou contra tua serva, dizendo: Entrega ao que matou a seu irmão, para que lhe façamos morrer pela vida de seu irmão a quem ele matou, e tiremos também o herdeiro. Assim apagarão a brasa que me restou, não deixaram a meu marido nome nem remanescente sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: Behold, the whole family has risen against your servant, and they say, ‘Deliver him who struck his brother, that we may kill him for the life of his brother whom he killed, and so destroy the heir also.’ Thus they would quench my coal which is left, and would leave to my husband neither name nor remainder on the surface of the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: And now all the family is turned against me, your servant, saying, Give up him who was the cause of his brother's death, so that we may put him to death in payment for the life of his brother, whose life he took; and we will put an end to the one who will get the heritage: so they will put out my last burning coal, and my husband will have no name or offspring on the face of the earth.

verses.en: And the king said unto the woman, Go to thine house, and I will give charge concerning thee.
verses.pt: Então o rei disse à mulher: Vai-te à tua casa, que eu mandarei acerca de ti.
verses.en_web: The king said to the woman, “Go to your house, and I will give a command concerning you.”
verses.en_bbe: And the king said to the woman, Go to your house and I will give orders about this.

verses.en: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house: and the king and his throne be guiltless.
verses.pt: E a mulher de Tecoa disse ao rei: Rei senhor meu, a maldade seja sobre mim e sobre a casa de meu pai; mas o rei e seu trono sem culpa.
verses.en_web: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord, O king, may the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house; and may the king and his throne be guiltless.”
verses.en_bbe: And the woman of Tekoa said to the king, My lord, O king, may the sin be on me and on my family, and may the king and the seat of his kingdom be clear of sin!

verses.en: And the king said, Whosoever saith ought unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.
verses.pt: E o rei disse: Ao que falar contra ti, traze-o a mim, que não te tocará mais.
verses.en_web: The king said, “Whoever says anything to you, bring him to me, and he will not bother you any more.”
verses.en_bbe: And the king said, If anyone says anything to you, make him come to me, and he will do you no more damage.

verses.en: Then said she, I pray thee, let the king remember the LORD thy God, that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, As the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth.
verses.pt: Disse ela então: Rogo-te, ó rei, que te lembres do SENHOR teu Deus, que não deixes ao vingador do sangue aumentar o dano em destruir meu filho. E ele respondeu: Vive o SENHOR, que não cairá nem um cabelo da cabeça de teu filho em terra.
verses.en_web: Then she said, “Please let the king remember Yahweh your God, that the avenger of blood destroy not any more, lest they destroy my son.” He said, “As Yahweh lives, not one hair of your son shall fall to the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: Then she said, Let the king keep in mind the Lord your God, so that he who gives punishment for blood may be kept back from further destruction and that no one may send death on my son. And he said, By the living Lord, not a hair of your son's head will come to the earth.

verses.en: Then the woman said, Let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak one word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.
verses.pt: E a mulher disse: Rogo-te que fale tua criada uma palavra a meu senhor o rei. E ele disse: Fala.
verses.en_web: Then the woman said, “Please let your servant speak a word to my lord the king.” He said, “Say on.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the woman said, Will the king let his servant say one word more? And he said, Say on.

verses.en: And the woman said, Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty, in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished.
verses.pt: Então a mulher disse: Por que pois pensas tu outro tanto contra o povo de Deus? que falando o rei esta palavra, é como culpado, porquanto o rei não faz voltar a seu fugitivo.
verses.en_web: The woman said, “Why then have you devised such a thing against the people of God? For in speaking this word the king is as one who is guilty, in that the king does not bring home again his banished one.
verses.en_bbe: And the woman said, Why have you had such a thought about the people of God? (for in saying these very words the king has put himself in the wrong because he has not taken back the one whom he sent far away.)

verses.en: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect any person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.
verses.pt: Porque de certo morremos, e somos como águas derramadas por terra, que não podem voltar a recolher-se: nem Deus tira a vida, mas sim planeja meio para que seu desviado não seja dele excluído.
verses.en_web: For we must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can’t be gathered up again; neither does God take away life, but devises means, that he who is banished not be an outcast from him.
verses.en_bbe: For death comes to us all, and we are like water drained out on the earth, which it is not possible to take up again; and God will not take away the life of the man whose purpose is that he who has been sent away may not be completely cut off from him.

verses.en: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid: and thy handmaid said, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.
verses.pt: E que eu vim agora para dizer isto ao rei meu senhor, é porque o povo me pôs medo. Mas tua serva disse: Falarei agora ao rei: talvez ele faça o que sua serva diga.
verses.en_web: Now therefore seeing that I have come to speak this word to my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid. Your servant said, ‘I will now speak to the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his servant.’
verses.en_bbe: And now it is my fear of the people which has made me come to say these words to my lord the king: and your servant said, I will put my cause before the king, and it may be that he will give effect to my request.

verses.en: For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.
verses.pt: Pois o rei ouvirá, para livrar à sua serva da mão do homem que me quer exterminar a mim, e a meu filho juntamente, da propriedade de Deus.
verses.en_web: For the king will hear, to deliver his servant out of the hand of the man who would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.
verses.en_bbe: For the king will give ear, and take his servant out of the power of the man whose purpose is the destruction of me and my son together from the heritage of God.

verses.en: Then thine handmaid said, The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable: for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad: therefore the LORD thy God will be with thee.
verses.pt: Tua serva, pois, disse: Que seja agora a resposta de meu senhor o rei para descanso; pois que meu senhor o rei é como um anjo de Deus para escutar o bem e o mal. Assim o SENHOR teu Deus seja contigo.
verses.en_web: Then your servant said, ‘Please let the word of my lord the king bring rest; for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad. May Yahweh, your God, be with you.’”
verses.en_bbe: Then your servant said, May the word of my lord the king give me peace! for my lord the king is as the angel of God in his hearing of good and bad: and may the Lord your God be with you!

verses.en: Then the king answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me, I pray thee, the thing that I shall ask thee. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.
verses.pt: Então ele respondeu, e disse à mulher: Eu te rogo que não me encubras nada do que eu te perguntar. E a mulher disse: Fale meu senhor o rei.
verses.en_web: Then the king answered the woman, “Please don’t hide anything from me that I ask you.” The woman said, “Let my lord the king now speak.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the king said to the woman, Now give me an answer to the question I am going to put to you; keep nothing back. And the woman said, Let my lord the king say on.

verses.en: And the king said, Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this? And the woman answered and said, As thy soul liveth, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken: for thy servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid:
verses.pt: E o rei disse: Não foi a mão de Joabe contigo em todas estas coisas? E a mulher respondeu e disse: Vive tua alma, rei senhor meu, que não há que desviar-se à direita nem à esquerda de tudo o que meu senhor o rei falou: porque teu servo Joabe, ele me mandou, e ele pôs na boca de tua serva todas estas palavras.
verses.en_web: The king said, “Is the hand of Joab with you in all this?” The woman answered, “As your soul lives, my lord the king, no one can turn to the right hand or to the left from anything that my lord the king has spoken; for your servant Joab urged me, and he put all these words in the mouth of your servant;
verses.en_bbe: And the king said, Is not the hand of Joab with you in all this? And the woman in answer said, By the life of your soul, my lord the king, it is not possible for anyone to go to the right hand or to the left from anything said by the king: your servant Joab gave me orders, and put all these words in my mouth:

verses.en: To fetch about this form of speech hath thy servant Joab done this thing: and my lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.
verses.pt: E Joabe, teu servo o fez, modificando a aparência do assunto; mas meu senhor é sábio, conforme a sabedoria de um anjo de Deus, para conhecer o que há na terra.
verses.en_web: to change the face of the matter has your servant Joab done this thing. My lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: This he did, hoping that the face of this business might be changed: and my lord is wise, with the wisdom of the angel of God, having knowledge of everything on earth.

verses.en: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.
verses.pt: Então o rei disse a Joabe: Eis que eu faço isto: vai, e faze voltar ao jovem Absalão.
verses.en_web: The king said to Joab, “Behold now, I have done this thing. Go therefore, and bring the young man Absalom back.”
verses.en_bbe: And the king said to Joab, See now, I will do this thing: go then and Come back with the young man Absalom.

verses.en: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and bowed himself, and thanked the king: and Joab said, Today thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight, my lord, O king, in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant.
verses.pt: E Joabe se prostrou em terra sobre seu rosto, e fez reverência, e depois que abençoou ao rei, disse: Hoje há entendido teu servo que achei favor em teus olhos, rei senhor meu; pois que fez o rei o que seu servo disse.
verses.en_web: Joab fell to the ground on his face, showed respect, and blessed the king. Joab said, “Today your servant knows that I have found favor in your sight, my lord, king, in that the king has performed the request of his servant.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Joab, falling down on his face on the earth, gave the king honour and blessing; and Joab said, Today it is clear to your servant that I have grace in your eyes, my lord king, because the king has given effect to the request of his servant.

verses.en: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Levantou-se logo Joabe, e foi a Gesur, e voltou a Absalão a Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: So Joab got up and went to Geshur and came back again to Jerusalem with Absalom.

verses.en: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king’s face.
verses.pt: Mas o rei disse: Vá-se à sua casa, e não veja meu rosto. E voltou-se Absalão à sua casa, e não viu o rosto do rei.
verses.en_web: The king said, “Let him return to his own house, but let him not see my face.” So Absalom returned to his own house, and didn’t see the king’s face.
verses.en_bbe: And the king said, Let him go to his house, but let him not see my face. So Absalom went back to his house and did not see the face of the king.

verses.en: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.
verses.pt: E não havia em todo Israel homem tão elogiado por sua beleza como Absalão; desde a planta de seu pé até ao topo da cabeça não havia nele defeito.
verses.en_web: Now in all Israel there was no one to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty. From the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no defect in him.
verses.en_bbe: Now in all Israel there was no one so greatly to be praised for his beautiful form as Absalom: from his feet to the crown of his head he was completely beautiful.

verses.en: And when he polled his head, (for it was at every year’s end that he polled it: because the hair was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king’s weight.
verses.pt: E quando se cortava o cabelo, (o qual fazia ao fim de cada ano, pois lhe incomodava, e por isso se o cortava,) pesava o cabelo de sua cabeça duzentos siclos de peso real.
verses.en_web: When he cut the hair of his head (now it was at every year’s end that he cut it; because it was heavy on him, therefore he cut it); he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels, after the king’s weight.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had his hair cut, (which he did at the end of every year, because of the weight of his hair;) the weight of the hair was two hundred shekels by the king's weight.

verses.en: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.
verses.pt: E nasceram-lhe a Absalão três filhos, e uma filha que se chamou Tamar, a qual era bela de ver.
verses.en_web: Three sons were born to Absalom, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar. She was a woman with a beautiful face.
verses.en_bbe: And Absalom was the father of three sons and of one daughter named Tamar, who was very beautiful.

verses.en: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the king’s face.
verses.pt: E esteve Absalão por espaço de dois anos em Jerusalém, e não viu a cara do rei.
verses.en_web: Absalom lived two full years in Jerusalem, and he didn’t see the king’s face.
verses.en_bbe: For two full years Absalom was living in Jerusalem without ever seeing the face of the king.

verses.en: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, to have sent him to the king; but he would not come to him: and when he sent again the second time, he would not come.
verses.pt: E mandou Absalão por Joabe, para enviá-lo ao rei; mas não quis vir a ele; ele mandou mensagem ainda pela segunda vez, mas não quis vir.
verses.en_web: Then Absalom sent for Joab, to send him to the king, but he would not come to him. Then he sent again a second time, but he would not come.
verses.en_bbe: Then Absalom sent for Joab to send him to the king, but he would not come to him: and he sent again a second time, but he would not come.

verses.en: Therefore he said unto his servants, See, Joab’s field is near mine, and he hath barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.
verses.pt: Então disse a seus servos: Bem sabeis as terras de Joabe junto a meu lugar, de onde tem suas cevadas; ide, e pegai-lhes fogo; e os servos de Absalão pegaram fogo às terras.
verses.en_web: Therefore he said to his servants, “Behold, Joab’s field is near mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire.” So Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.
verses.en_bbe: So he said to his servants, See, Joab's field is near mine, and he has barley in it; go and put it on fire. And Absalom's servants put the field on fire.

verses.en: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto his house, and said unto him, Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire?
verses.pt: Levantou-se, portanto, Joabe, e veio a Absalão à sua casa, e disse-lhe: Por que puseram fogo teus servos a minhas terras?
verses.en_web: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom to his house, and said to him, “Why have your servants set my field on fire?”
verses.en_bbe: Then Joab came to Absalom in his house and said to him, Why have your servants put my field on fire?

verses.en: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto thee, saying, Come hither, that I may send thee to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? it had been good for me to have been there still: now therefore let me see the king’s face; and if there be any iniquity in me, let him kill me.
verses.pt: E Absalão respondeu a Joabe: Eis que, eu enviei por ti, dizendo que viesses aqui, a fim de enviar-te eu ao rei a que lhe dissesses: Para que vim de Gesur? Melhor me fora estar ainda lá. Veja eu agora a cara do rei; e se há em mim pecado, mate-me.
verses.en_web: Absalom answered Joab, “Behold, I sent to you, saying, ‘Come here, that I may send you to the king, to say, “Why have I come from Geshur? It would be better for me to be there still. Now therefore let me see the king’s face, and if there is iniquity in me, let him kill me.”’”
verses.en_bbe: And Absalom's answer was, See, I sent to you saying, Come here, so that I may send you to the king to say, Why have I come back from Geshur? it would be better for me to be there still: let me now see the king's face, and if there is any sin in me, let him put me to death.

verses.en: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.
verses.pt: Veio, pois, Joabe ao rei, e fê-lo saber. Então chamou a Absalão, o qual veio ao rei, e inclinou seu rosto em terra diante do rei: e o rei beijou a Absalão.
verses.en_web: So Joab came to the king, and told him; and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king; and the king kissed Absalom.
verses.en_bbe: So Joab went to the king and said these words to him: and when the king had sent for him, Absalom came, and went down on his face on the earth before the king: and the king gave him a kiss.
